hardware_dossier.transmitter: Modified surplus Callisto Ice-Harvester PA deck (2x ceramic tetrodes in Class-C AM plate modulation), tapping 440V three-phase power off the Dome-4 streetlamp transformer after 2100 J-Dome time.
hardware_dossier.feedline_anomaly: High standing-wave ratio (SWR 3.8:1) due to noodle-stall grease condensation on the open-wire feeder. At 0401:18 GCT, station engineer climbed onto the corrugated arch with an oxy-acetylene blowtorch to braze the center insulator while the transmitter remained at full carrier—producing an 18.4 dB plasma-arc overmodulation spike heard all the way to the Oort Cloud.
hardware_dossier.receive_antenna_at_gor9: High Basalt Shelf 4-Ring Apex Phased Array (Beam 212.4°)

characters.signature_quote: Hold the mic, Mei-Ling—give me a kiss for luck before I hit the center insulator with the oxy-torch!
characters.bio: Former Ganymede ice-harvester radar technician who runs Stall 19 ('Hand-Pulled Beef Broth & Surplus Tetrodes') with his partner Mei-Ling. Built Radio Corrugated out of a salvaged ice-harvester PA deck tapping 440V off the municipal sodium streetlamps after 2100 local time.
characters.language_sample_transcript: Wei! Callisto Dome-Four Night Market, Stall Nineteen on eleven-four-ten kilohertz! Hao le, Ah-Mei, pass me the silver-copper brazing rod—watch the plate current climb eighteen decibels when I touch the torch to the radiator!
characters.phonetic_and_conlang_notes: Callisto Dome-4 Dock Patois: blends Cantonese/Mandarin night-market exclamations ('Wei!', 'Hao le!') with vacuum-tube RF slang.

worldbuilding.habitat_and_culture: Sub-Level 3 of Callisto Dome-4 is a labyrinth of wet corrugated-iron roofs, venting steam pipes, and neon noodle stalls where independent tug crews trade contraband vacuum tubes and dodge Jovian Authority customs sweeps.
worldbuilding.spectrum_gimmick_title: Live Blowtorch Plasma-Arc Overmodulation (+18.4 dB) & Rooftop Romance
worldbuilding.hauser_commentary: Callisto Dome-4 on 11410.042—drifting up 42 Hz every time downstairs fires up the noodle cauldron. Co-hosts Chen and Mei-Ling reading docking-bay contraband prices until 0401, when the carrier jumped 18 dB in a violent plasma buzz right as Chen hit the dipole center-insulator with his blowtorch and kissed Mei-Ling on the roof.
worldbuilding.qsl_postcard_style: Pirate Couple Rooftop Snapshot Postcard (inspired by Radio Andorra & Voice of Pancho Villa)
worldbuilding.qsl_animation_notes: 2-frame Kodachrome action sequence: Chen and Mei-Ling grin with the blowtorch and noodle bowl, then lean in and kiss on the rooftop while the blowtorch erupts in a cyan-white plasma arc against the copper dipole!

discovery_arc.summary: Caught S9+18 dB blowtorch spike at 0401 GCT as Chen brazed the live rooftop dipole and kissed Mei-Ling; decoded octal group [351 • 047] in the arc's sub-band FSK tail.
Harbor Patrol cuts power to Sub-Level 3 streetlamps at 0408 GCT; the couple switches to emergency bicycle-dynamo power (18 Watts) while directing listeners to Quarantine Buoy 12.
Chen and Mei-Ling offer an autographed Tier-I Blowtorch QSL and three crates of pickled radish to whichever outpost smuggles two 811A oscillator tubes past Buoy 12.
